verdict.rationale: Clerky's agent surfaces don't cover this story. Its MCP server is OAuth-gated and documented as read-only with team-scoped access, so an agent cannot prepare or submit filings through it. The Partner API currently supports only Delaware C-Corp formation, with OAuth still 'coming soon'. No evidence shows an agent preparing an annual report or compliance filing. The online IRS-form submission and the post-incorporation maintenance tools are human-driven platform features, not agent-delegated workflows.
